name: STAT
description: The daily lives of the personnel of the St-Vincent hospital in Montréal.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Isabelle wants to update her will regarding Siméon’s custody in case of misfortune. Pascal and Régis argue about the delays in surgical procedures.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The team begins to notice some surprising behaviors from Ève Lemieux. Steve brings up the subject with her. Régis explains to Anthony the nature of the procedure he performed on him. Emmanuelle tells Pascal that she is leaving immediately to spend a few days in Trenton to take part in the Armed Forces investigation.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Isabelle and Pascal have dinner at the restaurant. The conversation notably concerns her replacement in the operating room. Anne-Marie is back at the emergency room, this time complaining of urinary discomfort. Delphine pleads with Marc-André, Ève’s brother, to keep taking care of Charlie for a while. Pascal welcomes Raphaël St-Vincent.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Marc-Olivier shares information about Anne-Marie’s case with Jacob. Pascal calls the team to a special meeting to introduce Raphaël. Éric and Steve comfort Éloi, Vicky’s boyfriend. Delphine has a first meeting with Ève before exchanging confidences with Éric.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: While it’s all hands on deck at the emergency room, Raphaël runs after Sophia to get her to explain what is going on, but she is too busy. It is ultimately Pascal who brings him up to speed. In Trenton, Emmanuelle confides in Julian, and Daniel does not hesitate to tell Raphaël what he thinks.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: An initiative by Raphaël causes quite a stir in the hospital. Steve explains to Gabriel the case of Félix Lemoine, who has just been transferred to the ward. Félix receives a visit from his girlfriend Frédérique, who is very worried. Gabriel and Philippe try to be reassuring. In a meeting, Pascal announces something surprising.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Éric helps Anthony take a first ride in a wheelchair. Raphaël mobilizes Jacob, Sophia, and Éric. Philippe explains to Frédérique what lies ahead for Félix. Raphaël ends up having a conversation with Emmanuelle.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Jacob shares with Steve and Delphine a discovery concerning Charlie. Steve quickly informs his mother Ève, while Delphine asks Marc-André to come meet her at the hospital. Sophia encourages Marc-Olivier, who is going through a difficult time. Raphaël tells Pascal that he must be away to take care of another assignment, without revealing what it is.

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: Emmanuelle explains to Roseline's son that his fall was due to a worsening of his health. At the meeting, the team takes stock of the young victims of the explosion. Éric returns from court and tells Emmanuelle what happened.

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: Éric tells Amina she's being moved to a double room; the investigators now question chemistry teacher Joël; Isabelle urges Eva-Jade's father to reason with his wife.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: Audrey discusses Roseline's case with Marco, who has to look after her overnight; Isabelle takes her last chemo treatment with her neighbor Christine.

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: Emmanuelle looks after Samuel, who has fainted in the waiting room; Ève, who is accompanying Charlie to the ophthalmologist, goes to Philippe's office, hoping to meet him.

videos.title: Episode 75
videos.overview: As the funeral approaches, Jérémie helps Rosalie work on the text she's going to read; when Emmanuelle arrives, he sees that she's quite upset; Laurent welcomes Antoine Diamond, the new emergency psychiatrist.

videos.title: Episode 76
videos.overview: Emmanuelle and Jacob discuss Samuel's case; Jacob explains to Antoine why Emmanuelle is so cold to him; Pascal argues with Simeon, who doesn't want to dress up for the funeral.
